decision.minimum_missing_evidence: rerun a paired cache-request matrix while persisting its complete per-anchor z trace and decoded ImageReward/VQA harm, then test a frozen implication on a separate request-level holdout
decision.p3_design_constraint: do not implement one global raw-z commit threshold; retain phase/scheduler weighting and a cumulative deficit ledger as candidates until paired semantic traces are collected
decision.reason: raw max z is dominated by a shared early segment and is weakly related to composed path harm; additionally, same-request per-segment z and ImageReward/VQA harm are not jointly present, so an open-loop latent bound cannot certify the semantic quality contract

protocol.open_loop_limitation: real-anchor velocities are read from the full-compute path; policy-induced latent distribution shift is not represented
protocol.primary_gate: at the development q75 max-z envelope, every holdout prompt must have accepted masks and no accepted holdout harm may exceed the development maximum

frontier_case_study.interpretation: the shared early segment fixes max z while later segment composition materially changes end-to-end path harm

raw_max_z_usefulness_diagnostic.reason: holdout rank correlation is weak and the A12/A13 frontier pair has identical max-z q95 despite materially different end-to-end path harm

semantic_bridge_audit.reason: natural-range evaluations contain decoded per-request semantic harm but no per-anchor z trace; the 1216 value in A12 runner_stats is 38 skips x 32 requests, not 1216 causal labels
